messages:
Gina Torres: Quick sync  we need a bite-sized migration note and a tiny compatibility checklist for teams before we flip the redirect. Who can take the sample conversions and the redirect path list?

Hector Suarez: Ill do Python + Node samples. Plan: show a one-line before/after plus a short comment about streaming callback rename.

Lin Wu: I can take the central migration doc edits and a short troubleshooting FAQ. Add micro-examples for embed dim warnings too.

Gina Torres: Awesome. For samples keep the new v2 call `responses.create` and prefer `model` over `model_id` in quickstarts. Add a note that production should pin `model_id` for stability.

Hector Suarez: Draft snippet (to go in SDK READMEs):
```
# v1 (before)
client.generate(model_name="rwd-small", input="hi")

# v2 (after)
client.responses.create(model="redwood-small-v2", input="hi")
# streaming: onData -> onDelta
```
I'll put that in PRs and tag Lin for link review.

Lin Wu: For the doc I'll include a tiny regex list for bulk edits and a conservative note about false positives. Regex examples: `s/\bmodel_name\b/model/g`, `s/\bonData\b/onDelta/g`.

DocsQA: Reminder: add a smoke-test template id in each PR comment. QA will run the smoke flow and paste results back (pass/fail + short notes).

InfraBot: deploy-checks/6998881234: created job template `docs-compat-699888`. Assign on merge.

Gina Torres: Also, please enumerate exact internal paths referencing /v1 (only paths, not full URLs) in PR comment so infra can wire redirects. Example list format: ["/v1/models", "/v1/generate", "/v1/embeddings"].

Hector Suarez: Will add that list to my PR. One more: let's keep v1 examples visible for 72 hours after redirect with a short banner "legacy example" so customers can quickly compare.

Lin Wu: Good catch. I'll add that to the migration doc and include a tiny rollback checklist for canaries: smoke id, p50/p95 baseline, error-rate threshold, and three semantic prompts to sanity-check.

Gina Torres: Perfect. Action items recap: Hector  SDK snippets + PRs; Lin  migration doc + FAQ + path list; Gina  banner timing and cross-team notif. We'll mark all PRs `migration/v1-v2` and add the checklist comment (owner, reviewer, smoke-template). Recheck here after PRs land. :white_check_mark:
